integrity: The universal statements are proved by finite-dimensional linear algebra. The bundled exact verifier checks only finite Sylvester instances and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The universal lower bound and minimum-length pairing rigidity hold for real finite-dimensional Banach spaces. The existence construction for real ell_1^n requires a real Hadamard matrix of order n+1 and therefore does not settle every dimension or every admissible length.
title: Minimal balanced Banach FUNTFs have simplex pairing, with Hadamard realizations in \(\ell_1^n\)
